stem: Two chords $AB$ and $CD$ intersect at point $E$ inside a circle. The arc $AC$ intercepted by $\angle AEC$ measures ${=a}^\circ$ and the arc $BD$ intercepted by its vertical angle $\angle BED$ measures ${=b}^\circ$. Find $m\angle AEC$ in degrees.
solution: For two chords intersecting inside a circle, the angle equals half the sum of the intercepted arcs.
notes: No book questions were supplied for this objective; parent_question_id is a placeholder (the objective id) and needs a human to assign a real parent. Basic: direct half-sum.
